hypothesis: Sizing the OpenMP team to physical cores instead of one thread per logical CPU raises throughput on an SMT host, because ~720 parallel regions per decoded token make the per-region barrier a first-order cost rather than a rounding error.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, released checkpoint, 48 shards, 510.3 GB, fp8 dense + fp4 experts, no conversion
command: SNAP=/mnt/nvme0/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ./deepseek_v41 8 /tmp/ref.json (25 prompt tokens, 16 generated, cap=8, page cache evicted per run; no OMP_NUM_THREADS and no COLI_NO_OMP_TUNE set)

hardware.cpu: 2x Intel Xeon Platinum 8555C, 52 cores/socket, 2 threads/core = 104 physical cores, 208 logical CPUs, 4 NUMA nodes

quality.method: token-exact vs a 16-token reference stream; the engine exits non-zero on any mismatch. All 6 runs 16/16. tok_s is 16 generated tokens over the whole turn (READY to DONE), prefill included
